title: ClaudeBrain
description: Your Claude history, read-only. Full-text search: try a canned query below, or the search box on messages.

search.title: Search the conversation
search.description: Words are ANDed; word* for prefixes, "exact phrase", OR between words. Tool calls left out.
search.sql: SELECT m.ts, s.project, s.title, m.role, snippet(messages_fts, 0, '[', ']', '…', 24) AS snippet, m.session_id FROM messages_fts JOIN messages m ON m.rowid = messages_fts.rowid JOIN sessions s USING (session_id) WHERE messages_fts MATCH :q AND m.role != 'tool' AND m.is_sidechain = 0 ORDER BY rank LIMIT 100

session.title: Read a session
session.description: Paste a session id or its first 8 characters.
session.sql: SELECT ts, role, text FROM messages WHERE session_id LIKE :id || '%' AND role != 'tool' AND is_sidechain = 0 ORDER BY ts

projects.title: Projects
projects.sql: SELECT project, COUNT(*) AS sessions, SUM(msg_count) AS messages, MIN(first_ts) AS first, MAX(last_ts) AS last FROM sessions WHERE msg_count > 0 GROUP BY project ORDER BY last DESC

project_timeline.title: A project's sessions
project_timeline.sql: SELECT session_id, first_ts, last_ts, entrypoint, msg_count, title FROM sessions WHERE project = :project AND msg_count > 0 ORDER BY first_ts
